title: Starts (starts.json)
description: Other ways to begin a game: a new game as the pack starts it, then the start's effects, run by the player. Makers use them to playtest from anywhere (play.py --start <id>, or the /dev menu); they never show in normal play.

$schema.description: Path to this file's schema, for editors. Ignored by the engine.

start.description: A way to begin: the pack's usual new game, then these effects, run by the player ('self'). Move them somewhere (move_to), give them things (give_item, learn_design), set the world up (set_flag, set_state, join_party, change_relation), or begin with a fight or an event (start_encounter, trigger_event).

description.description: What the start sets up, for whoever picks it.

effects.description: Run in order, by the player, right after the new game begins.

playable.description: Offer this start to players on the start screen, as a scenario to begin with.
